summary.goal: Provide conversational interface for brainstorming with the Interviewer agent, displaying transcript and handling real-time message updates.
reuse_from_planner_ui: usePlanEvents hook pattern -> adapt for useSessionEvents (SSE)

acceptance_criteria.description: Messages displayed in chat bubble format (user right, Interviewer left)
Chat is pure user <-> Interviewer (no specialist messages in transcript)
Text input at bottom with send button
Messages appear in real-time via SSE
Loading indicator while waiting for Interviewer response
Session header shows confidence bar and 'Send to Planner' action

decisions.rationale: Interviewer facilitates - surfaces specialist insights when appropriate. Specialists show in sidebar panel.

steps.title: Create useSession hook
steps.description: Hook to fetch single session with transcript

acceptance_criteria.description: useSession(sessionId) returns { session, loading, error, refetch }

steps.title: Create useSessionEvents hook
steps.description: Hook for SSE subscription to session updates

steps.title: Create ChatBubble component
steps.description: Individual message bubble with role-based styling (user or assistant only)

acceptance_criteria.description: ChatBubble({ message }) renders bubble with content
assistant role: left-aligned, bg-bg-tertiary, Interviewer avatar
ChatMessageList({ messages }) renders ChatBubble for each
Auto-scroll to bottom when new messages arrive
useRef for scroll container, scrollIntoView on update

steps.title: Create ChatInput component
steps.description: Text input with send button at bottom of chat

acceptance_criteria.description: Textarea that grows up to 4 lines
Send button (arrow icon) enabled when text present
Enter to send, Shift+Enter for newline

steps.title: Create useSendMessage hook
steps.description: Hook to send message and track pending state

acceptance_criteria.description: Optimistically adds user message to local state

steps.title: Create ConfidenceBar component
steps.description: Visual bar showing aggregate confidence from all specialists

acceptance_criteria.description: ConfidenceBar({ score }) renders segmented bar (5 segments)

steps.title: Create useConfidence hook
steps.description: Hook to fetch and subscribe to confidence updates

steps.title: Create ChatHeader component
steps.description: Header showing session info, confidence bar, and send-to-planner action

acceptance_criteria.description: Shows ConfidenceBar with current aggregate score
'Send to Planner' button with color matching confidence (red/orange/green)
Button always enabled (advisory confidence, not blocking)
If session.planner_sends.length > 0, show 'Update Plan' instead of 'Send to Planner'

steps.title: Create TypingIndicator component
steps.description: Animated indicator when Interviewer is responding

acceptance_criteria.description: Three animated dots in a bubble
Shown after user sends message until response arrives

steps.title: Create SessionChatView page
steps.description: Main chat view composing all components

acceptance_criteria.description: Uses useSessionEvents to update transcript in real-time
Shows TypingIndicator when waiting for response
